history.summary: Small freehold 1BR in Geylang fringe (D14) asking $1,381 psf vs verified recent project transactions averaging ~$1,527 psf — a genuine ~10% discount confirmed by web data, not just an algo artefact.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,381 psf sits roughly 10% below the project's last-12-month average of ~$1,527 psf (EdgeProp/SRX), giving real margin of safety at a low $699k quantum. The algo's age_adj_premium of -26.6% overstates the cheapness (it benchmarks against district peers), but even my conservative project-level read confirms a discount. Region (D14/OCR-RCR fringe) aligns with the v3.4 prior favouring non-CCR forward returns. Trailing appreciation of -5.0% (18 txns) is weak but the backtest says trailing CAGR has ~0 forward power, so I do not penalise it. Yield ~3.3% is decent for a 1BR.
red_flags: Thin own-size cohort (psf_cohort_txns=7) makes the precise discount uncertain
Geylang location carries resale/financing stigma and noise concerns flagged in reviews
Tiny 64-unit project means low transaction liquidity for a 5-7yr exit
Trailing 5yr CAGR negative (-5.0%) — flat-to-soft price history
catalysts: Freehold tenure with low absolute quantum keeps the buyer pool wide
Walkable to Paya Lebar/Eunos amenities and MRT; Paya Lebar commercial node growth
